# proxmox_node_firewall_options (Resource)

Manages Proxmox VE per-node firewall options through `/nodes/{node}/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_firewall_options" "pve_1" {
  node                = "pve-1"
  enable              = true
  log_level_in        = "info"
  protection_synflood = true
  nosmurfs            = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Proxmox node name. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the node firewall.
- `log_level_in` (String) Log level for incoming traffic.
- `log_level_out` (String) Log level for outgoing traffic.
- `log_level_forward` (String) Log level for forwarded traffic.
- `log_nf_conntrack` (Boolean) Enable logging of conntrack information.
- `ndp` (Boolean) Enable NDP (Neighbor Discovery Protocol).
- `nf_conntrack_allow_invalid` (Boolean) Allow invalid packets in conntrack.
- `nf_conntrack_helpers` (String) Enabled conntrack helpers.
- `nf_conntrack_max` (Number) Maximum number of conntrack entries.
- `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` (Number) Conntrack established timeout in seconds.
- `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_syn_recv` (Number) Conntrack SYN-RECV timeout in seconds.
- `nftables` (Boolean) Enable nftables.
- `nosmurfs` (Boolean) Enable smurf logging.
- `protection_synflood` (Boolean) Enable SYN flood protection.
- `protection_synflood_burst` (Number) SYN flood burst limit.
- `protection_synflood_rate` (Number) SYN flood rate limit.
- `smurf_log_level` (String) Log level for smurf packets.
- `tcp_flags` (Boolean) Enable TCP flags filtering.
- `tcp_flags_log_level` (String) Log level for illegal TCP flags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The node name.
